alternatives_rejected.why: Its own span self-time is unchanged (0.2->0.2ms, 0.99x); the inbound slowdown appears only on calls from checkoutservice, which is equally slow to 5 other callees (E2, E3). Its large latency-90 metric (E1) is therefore the caller-observed effect.

Its latency deviation (E1) is consistent with being one of the 6 callees that checkoutservice is uniformly slow to reach (E3). No evidence on the board shows a shippingservice-only fault, so it is better explained as downstream of checkoutservice's network delay.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect checkoutservice's pod network for injected latency (e.g., a tc netem qdisc or sidecar/network policy) and remove it. If the cause is unclear, restart or reschedule the checkoutservice pod onto a healthy node, then confirm outbound call latency returns to baseline.
